args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

The docstring claimed banker's rounding but the implementation used
ROUND_HALF_UP, causing tests/test_money.py to fail (2.665 -> 2.67
instead of 2.66). Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN as specified.

args.body:
## Summary

`src/money.py` claimed to implement banker's rounding per FIN-212 in its docstring, but actually used `ROUND_HALF_UP`. This caused the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py`:

- `round_money(Decimal("2.665"))` returned `2.67` (ROUND_HALF_UP) instead of the expected `2.66` (banker's rounding).

## Change

- Switch the rounding mode from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `round_money` so it matches the documented FIN-212 behavior.

## Testing

- CI (run `ci-0001`) passed on this branch, including `tests/test_money.py`.

## Notes

- No public API changes; this corrects behavior to what the docstring/spec already promised.
- Requesting @code-owner review per merge policy for main.
